messages:
Riley: Quick calendar question—orientation invite shows as 'All day' for me in calendar. Is that expected? The Zoom link is only in the email, not in the calendar event.

eng-onboarding-bot: Welcome! Orientation session scheduled 2026-04-05 10:00 ET (recurring). Recording will be posted to #new-hires within 24h.

Priya: Hi Riley — quick checklist: 1) Check your Google Calendar timezone (Settings > Time zone). 2) If the event looks wrong, open it and confirm the event's Time zone field. I'll paste the Zoom + .ics below.

Priya: Zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=abcd
ICS (add to calendar): https://files.redwood.com/orientation/2026-04-05.ics

Paste to create manually if needed:
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Redwood//Onboarding//EN
BEGIN:VEVENT
DTSTART:20260405T140000Z
DTEND:20260405T150000Z
SUMMARY:Redwood New Hire Orientation
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR

Mateo: FYI for folks in CET/CEST — 10:00 ET is 16:00 CEST. If you rely on calendar conversion double-check daylight savings on your machine.

Riley: Thanks! Where will the recording live? I'll be on call that afternoon and might need the recording.

Priya: Recording goes to Google Drive (Team Onboarding folder) and we'll post the link in this channel with a short transcript and chapter markers.

eng-onboarding-bot: Recording storage: Google Drive -> /Onboarding/2026/04-05. Transcript: autogenerated (English). I will post links here after upload.

Kira: Heads-up — some folks get duplicate invites due to mailbox forwarding. If you see two events, decline the duplicate labeled 'Onboarding (external)'. @Matt (People Ops) and I will clean duplicates after RSVPs close.

Riley: One more — my calendar showed 11:00 after I updated timezone to ET. Is the host timezone ET or PT?

Priya: Host is ET. Recurring events sometimes retain the original time zone. Open the event, click the timezone field and set both start and end to 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)'. That should fix future instances.

Matt (People Ops): Added a 24h reminder and a follow-up 1:1 slot for timezone-sensitive folks. If the orientation time absolutely doesn't work, reply here with preferred windows and we'll schedule a recap.

Riley: Awesome, thanks everyone :tada:
